Oct 16 | Closing Market Report

October 16, 2026 Todd E. Gleason Full Transcript View the website
The October 16th edition of the Closing Market Report, hosted by Todd Gleason, provides an overview of agricultural markets, shifting consumer demands, and weather forecasts. Market analyst Mike Zuzolo discusses recent trends in the commodity markets, highlighting the influence of inflation, the value of the dollar, and new European export routes on crop prices. The program also features insights from CoBank's Brian Earnest, who explains how the increasing use of GLP1 medications is altering meat consumption, driving demand for protein-dense, leaner beef cuts and poultry. Finally, Eric Snodgrass offers an agricultural weather update, detailing a recent cold front across the Corn Belt, the upcoming harvest window, and the anticipated effects of a strong El Niño winter on both North and South American agriculture.
